species_support: human recombinant CALCRL/RAMP2; mouse Calcrl/Ramp genetic systems

limitations: Molecular evidence is exact for the CALCRL/RAMP2 complex, while mouse knockout physiology provides contextual receptor dependence rather than a clean chain-specific affinity measurement. Relative RAMP2/RAMP3 weighting is species and context dependent.

species_support: human recombinant CALCRL/RAMP3; mouse Calcrl/Ramp genetic systems
assay_or_result: PMID 24199627 directly tests adrenomedullin binding and cAMP responses with human CALCRL/RAMP3 constructs and mutagenesis; PMID 22142144 tests human CALCRL/RAMP3 receptor activation; PMID 27940069 tests adrenomedullin responses in mouse Calcrl/Ramp genetic systems.
limitations: Molecular evidence is exact for the CALCRL/RAMP3 complex, while mouse knockout physiology provides contextual receptor dependence rather than a clean chain-specific affinity measurement. Relative RAMP2/RAMP3 weighting is species and context dependent.

assay_or_result: Processed/mature AMH binds AMHR2; AMHR2 recruits ACVR1-family type-I receptors and activates Smad signaling. ELISA, structural, mutational and cell-luciferase assays support the complex.
limitations: The procomplex requires proteolytic processing and receptor-chain composition varies by assay/species.

assay_or_result: ANXA1 or its active N-terminal peptide engages FPR2/ALX in receptor-dependent anti-inflammatory and signaling assays.
limitations: ANXA1 processing and peptide form vary by assay; FPR2 is also activated by other ligands.

assay_or_result: Mature Apela/ELABELA peptides activate APLNR/APJ in receptor signaling, developmental and physiological assays.
limitations: APELA is a precursor gene; mature peptide processing and isoform nomenclature differ across species.

assay_or_result: ApoA-I/HDL binds cubilin with high affinity in SPR and receptor-expressing cell assays; AMN is the cubilin trafficking/complex partner.
limitations: The bound species is ApoA-I on HDL, and CUBN is the binding subunit while AMN supports complex trafficking.

assay_or_result: ApoA1 binds TREM2 in protein/dot-blot or array assays and apolipoprotein-TREM2 interactions support TREM2-dependent uptake/phagocytic function.
limitations: Binding depends on lipidation/particle presentation and TREM2 signals through the TYROBP/DAP12 adaptor.

assay_or_result: ApoA2 is included among apolipoproteins identified as TREM2 ligands in unbiased binding assays, with cellular uptake/TREM2 dependence examined in the same evidence stream.
limitations: Lipoprotein lipidation and presentation affect affinity; the exact ApoA2 preparation and adaptor contribution should be retained as context.

assay_or_result: The cloned macrophage ApoB48 receptor/APOBR binds ApoB48-containing particles and mediates uptake in transfected CHO cells.
limitations: The tested ligand is ApoB48/lipoprotein particle rather than free ApoB protein.

assay_or_result: ApoB is among apolipoproteins shown to bind TREM2 in protein/dot-blot and array-based assays, with TREM2-dependent uptake evidence.
limitations: Binding depends on lipidation/particle presentation and TREM2 signals through the TYROBP/DAP12 adaptor.

assay_or_result: ApoE binds TREM2 with high affinity and supports TREM2-dependent phagocytosis/uptake in biochemical and microglial assays.
limitations: ApoE isoform, lipidation and particle context affect binding; TYROBP is the signaling adaptor.

assay_or_result: SorLA/SORL1 binds APP695 directly by SPR and in cells; SORL1-dependent trafficking alters APP processing and Aβ production.
limitations: APP isoform and SorLA domain composition affect binding; downstream effects are trafficking rather than canonical signaling.

assay_or_result: Mature amphiregulin from its transmembrane precursor binds/activates EGFR and induces EGFR-dependent signaling in receptor and cell assays.
limitations: AREG is synthesized as a membrane precursor and can act juxtacrine or after shedding.

assay_or_result: Beta-endorphin binds human MOR/OPRM1 with altered affinity in the A118G variant and produces receptor-dependent GIRK activity; additional zebrafish Oprm1 work supports processed opioid context.
limitations: POMC is the precursor; mature beta-endorphin is the tested ligand and receptor variant/species affects potency.

assay_or_result: Betacellulin stimulates EGFR tyrosine phosphorylation in cells expressing EGFR, with receptor-selective assays distinguishing EGFR from other ErbB receptors.
limitations: Cellular activation is the primary readout; binding affinity is not the main assay in this citation.

assay_or_result: Betacellulin stimulates ErbB4 tyrosine phosphorylation in cells expressing ErbB4, establishing receptor-specific activation.
limitations: Cellular activation is the primary readout; ErbB receptor expression system determines response magnitude.

assay_or_result: CADM1 isoforms mediate homotypic adhesion and mast-cell survival phenotypes in cell adhesion assays.
limitations: Isoform-specific extracellular domains and cell context affect adhesion strength.

assay_or_result: The study tests homophilic CADM3/Cadm3 interaction and shows its role in retina neuroepithelial cell adhesion/proliferation.
limitations: Tissue-specific isoform and junctional context may affect the phenotype.

assay_or_result: CGRP from CALCA requires the CLR/CALCRL-RAMP1 complex; receptor mutagenesis, binding, cAMP and internalization assays map the interaction.
limitations: The mature alpha-CGRP peptide, not the CALCA precursor, is the tested ligand; RAMP1 is required for receptor specificity.

assay_or_result: CCL19 binds CCR7-derived receptor material and stimulates CCR7-dependent G-protein activation/binding and uptake assays.
limitations: Peptide/receptor-fragment and receptor-variant systems do not reproduce all native-cell context.

assay_or_result: CCL21 receptor N-terminal interactions, BRET and calcium-mobilization assays establish CCR7 engagement and activation.
limitations: CCL21 C-terminal processing/tail length strongly affects activity.

assay_or_result: CCL26/eotaxin-3 is tested as a functional CCR3 ligand in transfectant and chemotaxis/signaling assays.
limitations: CCL26 also has reported antagonist/agonist actions at other receptors, but CCR3 activity is directly shown.

assay_or_result: Radiolabeled CCL3/MIP-1alpha binding to CCR5-expressing cells is measured by saturation/competition assays.
limitations: The cited paper focuses on antagonist inhibition, but the ligand-receptor binding assay is direct.

assay_or_result: CCL5/RANTES binding to DARC/ACKR1 is shown by radioligand/competitive binding across species and DARC-expressing tissues.
limitations: ACKR1 is atypical and generally does not signal through canonical G proteins; binding/scavenging is the relevant function.

assay_or_result: CCL7 binding to purified DARC/ACKR1 is resolved structurally, and competitive binding identifies CCL7 as a DARC ligand.
limitations: ACKR1 is atypical and lacks canonical G-protein signaling; binding/scavenging is the relevant function.

assay_or_result: CCL7 is tested in CCR1 binding and activation models using receptor N-terminal interactions and functional pharmacology.
limitations: CCL7 is a partial/context-dependent CCR1 agonist in some systems.

assay_or_result: CCL7/MCP-3 is tested in CCR2 ligand-uptake/competition and selective-binding/activation studies.
limitations: CCR2 engagement is partial and sensitive to chemokine processing, glycosaminoglycans and cell context.

assay_or_result: Competition binding using C-terminally tagged CCL7 in CCR3-expressing cells tests direct receptor binding.
limitations: The cited study emphasizes receptor selectivity and binding; downstream activation may be ligand-construct dependent.

assay_or_result: MCP-2/CCL8 binds CCR1-transfected cells and induces migration; subsequent CCR1 binding and biased-agonism assays test CCL8 directly.
limitations: N-terminal processing and biased signaling vary by assay and ligand preparation.

assay_or_result: Radioiodinated MCP-2/CCL8 binds CCR2B-transfected cells and induces migration; CCR2 signaling studies also test MCP-2 activation.
limitations: CCL8 is a partial/context-dependent CCR2 agonist and processing/GAG presentation can alter activity.

assay_or_result: CCL8/MCP-2 is tested as a CCR5 ligand/agonist in binding, migration and tumor-model receptor-dependence studies.
limitations: CCR5 is promiscuous and the functional phenotype is cell-context dependent.

species_support: mouse and human CCR1 assay systems
assay_or_result: CCL9/MIP-1gamma is an alternative CCR1 ligand; primary assays showed CCR1 agonism, chemotaxis, and enhanced activity after N-terminal processing.
limitations: Mature versus truncated CCL9 activity differs; source is ligand-processing and inflammation context.

assay_or_result: HVEM/TNFRSF14 bound CD160 and HVEM-transfected cells inhibited CD4 T-cell activation in a CD160-dependent manner.
limitations: HVEM can also engage BTLA; assay used human cells and receptor mutants.

assay_or_result: CEACAM5 was shown to interact specifically with CD1d through its B3 domain in biochemical and cell-based assays.
limitations: Interaction is domain- and glycoprotein-context dependent; source focuses intestinal homeostasis.

assay_or_result: The 2B4/CD244 receptor was structurally and biophysically characterized bound to CD48, including SPR measurements.
limitations: Mouse receptor-ligand system; signaling outcome depends on cellular context.

assay_or_result: CD97/ADGRE5-transfected COS cells adhered specifically to CD55-positive cells; CD55-deficient erythrocytes failed to adhere and anti-CD55 blocked adhesion.
limitations: Original assay is cell adhesion and does not define all ADGRE5 splice isoforms.

assay_or_result: ALCAM-Fc bound CD6-transfected COS cells, establishing ALCAM as a direct CD6 ligand in cell-binding assays.
limitations: Species and construct context are human ALCAM/CD6 transfectants.

assay_or_result: PD-L1/CD274 bound B7-1/CD80 only in cis on the same cell surface, supported by cell, ELISA, flow, and NanoBiT assays.
limitations: This is cis binding; it does not establish a conventional trans-ligand interaction.

assay_or_result: CEACAM5 bound CD8alpha and activated the CD8-associated Lck pathway in the cited primary study.
limitations: The result is glycoprotein/domain dependent and uses human intestinal models.

assay_or_result: CD96 promoted NK-cell target adhesion through interaction with poliovirus receptor/PVR/CD155 and supported cytotoxic function.
limitations: Cellular adhesion and cytotoxicity assays do not define all affinity or isoform details.

assay_or_result: Murine CD99 transfectants underwent calcium-dependent homophilic aggregation that was blocked by anti-CD99.

assay_or_result: PILRalpha/PILRA recognition of mouse CD99 required sialylated O-linked glycans and was tested as a specific receptor-ligand interaction.

assay_or_result: Purified E-cadherin ectodomains showed direct homophilic adhesive binding in AUC and SPR assays.

assay_or_result: Purified M-cadherin ectodomains showed direct homophilic binding in biophysical assays.

assay_or_result: Purified N-cadherin ectodomains showed direct homophilic binding in AUC and SPR assays.
limitations: Cadherin ectodomain and calcium conditions are required.

assay_or_result: Purified P-cadherin ectodomains showed direct homophilic binding in AUC and SPR assays.
limitations: Cadherin ectodomain and calcium conditions are required.

assay_or_result: Purified R-cadherin ectodomains showed direct homophilic binding in AUC and SPR assays.
limitations: Cadherin ectodomain and calcium conditions are required.

assay_or_result: VE-cadherin/CDH5 ectodomains formed calcium-dependent homophilic associations in solid-phase and cross-linking assays.

assay_or_result: The CEACAM1 N-terminal domain was structurally and mutationally analyzed as the homophilic adhesion interface.

assay_or_result: Structural and functional assays tested mature TSH, the CGA/TSHB heterodimer, bound to and activating TSHR.

assay_or_result: CLEC2D/LLT1 is a ligand for KLRB1/NKR-P1A; engagement inhibited NK-cell cytotoxicity and cytokine production in functional assays.

assay_or_result: Biophysical, structural, and cell-based assays delineated CNTN2 homodimerization and homophilic adhesion.

assay_or_result: GPR56/ADGRG1 N-terminal protein bound collagen III/Col3a1 in brain binding assays, and collagen III activated GPR56-dependent RhoA signaling.

assay_or_result: Purified CSF1 and CSF1R formed defined extracellular complexes with measured stoichiometry and species cross-reactivity.

assay_or_result: Cardiotrophin-1 bound LIFR and signaled through the LIFR-gp130/IL6ST receptor complex in binding and competition assays.

assay_or_result: Cathepsin G cleaved and activated PAR4/F2RL3, with biased signaling characterized in human platelet/receptor systems.

assay_or_result: Cathepsin G was identified as a chemotactic agonist for FPR1 in receptor-dependent functional assays.

assay_or_result: CXCL11 bound ACKR3/CXCR7 and elicited receptor-dependent beta-arrestin/scavenging behavior in the cited primary work.

assay_or_result: Primary CXCR3 ligand studies tested CXCL11 in receptor binding and receptor-dependent signaling/chemotaxis assays.

assay_or_result: Primary CXCR3 ligand studies tested CXCL9 in receptor binding and receptor-dependent signaling/chemotaxis assays.

assay_or_result: The primary structural/biophysical study found adhesive Dsc2-Dsg2 interactions among the tested desmosomal cadherins.

assay_or_result: The primary structural/biophysical study found adhesive Dsg1-Dsc3 interactions among the tested desmosomal cadherins.
limitations: Dsg1c notation is mapped to the Dsg1 ectodomain/chain used in the cited human study.

assay_or_result: EDA1/EDA-A1 receptor-binding-site assays and EDAR reporter/rescue studies support the EDA-EDAR relationship.

assay_or_result: The structural study directly compares EGF-bound EGFR dimers and shows ligand-dependent EGFR dimer stabilization and signaling kinetics.

assay_or_result: Epiregulin is directly identified as a ligand for ErbB1/EGFR and is structurally shown to stabilize EGFR dimers.
limitations: Epiregulin is released from a membrane precursor and produces ligand-specific dimer stability and partial-agonist behavior.

assay_or_result: The primary epiregulin study explicitly identifies ErbB4/ErbB-4 as an EREG receptor and discusses receptor-binding affinity.
limitations: ErbB4 signaling can occur in heterodimers and epiregulin processing/presentation affects activity.

assay_or_result: ESAM-expressing cells aggregate in a direct cell-adhesion assay through homophilic ESAM interactions.
limitations: This is a membrane adhesion pair rather than a soluble signaling ligand-receptor interaction.

assay_or_result: Surface-bound and soluble F11R/JAM-A homophilic interactions were tested in platelet adhesion, thrombus, blocking-antibody, and mouse thrombosis assays.
limitations: JAM-A also has cis-dimerization and PDZ-scaffold functions; the submitted edge is homophilic, not heterophilic JAM adhesion.

assay_or_result: Structural and mechanistic studies resolve glucagon/GCGR engagement and glucagon-dependent activation of the human glucagon receptor.
limitations: The 29300013 structure uses a glucagon analogue/partial agonist, while native glucagon receptor activity is established in the primary literature.

assay_or_result: Structural, binding, adhesion, and cerebellar synaptogenesis studies support the beta-neurexin-1-Cbln1-GluD2/GRID2 trans-synaptic bridge and GRID2-dependent synapse function.
limitations: This is a multicomponent trans-synaptic adhesion/organizer complex rather than a conventional soluble agonist; neurexin splice state and Cbln1 assembly affect the interaction.

assay_or_result: The GPHB5-GPHA2 thyrostimulin heterodimer binds and activates TSHR in receptor-binding, cAMP, and thyroid-axis assays.
limitations: The ligand is a processed heterodimer and potency is species- and assay-dependent.

assay_or_result: Qa-1b/H2-T23 presenting Qdm binds the assembled CD94/NKG2A heterodimer and inhibits NK/T-cell cytotoxicity; the 2024 structure resolves the receptor-chain interface.
limitations: Recognition requires peptide-loaded Qa-1b and the assembled KLRD1/KLRC1 receptor; peptide identity strongly affects affinity.

assay_or_result: Primary murine studies report Qa-1b binding to CD94/NKG2C and activating-receptor recognition; the receptor is the KLRD1/KLRC2 heterodimer.
limitations: The 38158698 structure is NKG2A-specific; NKG2C support comes from the cited earlier receptor-binding/functional studies and remains peptide/context dependent.

assay_or_result: H60A is directly established as a murine NKG2D/KLRK1 ligand by binding and receptor-dependent NK/epithelial activation studies.
limitations: H60 allele expression is stress- and tissue-dependent; NKG2D signaling requires the associated DAP10 adaptor.

assay_or_result: HB-EGF binds and activates HER1/EGFR in binding, phosphorylation, chemotaxis, and receptor-dependent assays.
limitations: HB-EGF is a membrane precursor that can be shed as a soluble ligand; ligand presentation and receptor abundance affect response.

assay_or_result: HB-EGF directly binds HER4/ErbB4 and induces receptor phosphorylation and receptor-dependent chemotaxis.
limitations: HB-EGF is a membrane precursor/soluble cleaved ligand and HER4 signaling differs from EGFR mitogenic responses.

assay_or_result: Mature amidated amylin/IAPP binds and activates the CALCR-RAMP1 AMY1 receptor in competitive-binding, cAMP, and modern receptor-complex studies.
limitations: IAPP is a precursor processed to mature amylin; species, CALCR splice form, and RAMP-dependent pharmacology affect potency.

assay_or_result: Mature amylin/IAPP engages the CALCR-RAMP2 AMY2 receptor in receptor-complex pharmacology and structural/functional studies.
limitations: Older cotransfection data were less sensitive for RAMP2 than RAMP1/3; newer AMY2 receptor studies support the assembled complex.

assay_or_result: Mature amylin/IAPP binds and activates the CALCR-RAMP3 AMY3 receptor in competitive-binding, cAMP, and receptor-complex studies.
limitations: IAPP is a precursor processed to mature amylin; species and RAMP-dependent pharmacology affect potency.

assay_or_result: IFN-alpha-2 binding to IFNAR1/IFNAR2 ternary complexes and receptor-dependent antiviral/antiproliferative signaling are directly tested.
limitations: IFNAR1/2 is a ternary receptor assembly and IFN-alpha subtype affinity differs.

assay_or_result: The receptor-discovery study identifies IFN-lambda-2 as a ligand using the IFNLR1/IL10RB two-chain complex and demonstrates receptor-dependent antiviral signaling.
limitations: IL10RB is shared by other cytokine receptors and ligand subtype potency differs.

assay_or_result: The receptor-discovery study identifies IFN-lambda-3 as a ligand using the IFNLR1/IL10RB two-chain complex and demonstrates receptor-dependent antiviral signaling.
limitations: IL10RB is shared by other cytokine receptors and ligand subtype potency differs.

assay_or_result: IGFBP3 binds the single-span TMEM219/IGFBP3R and induces caspase-8-dependent apoptosis; knockdown, overexpression, blockade, and in vivo studies support receptor dependence.
limitations: IGFBP3 also carries IGF ligands and has other extracellular interactions; soluble versus matrix-associated presentation can change responses.

assay_or_result: Mutational receptor-binding studies identify IL13RA1 residues required for IL-13 binding, and IL13RA1 is the ligand-binding chain of the signaling type-II receptor.
limitations: IL13RA1 normally functions in a receptor complex with IL4R; binding and signaling are not identical readouts.

assay_or_result: IL-13 directly binds IL13RA2; structural/mutational work supports the high-affinity decoy interaction and receptor-dependent sequestration.
limitations: IL13RA2 is generally non-signaling/decoy, so this is binding and neutralization rather than canonical signaling activation.

assay_or_result: The complete type-II IL-13/IL4R/IL13RA1 ternary complex was structurally resolved and shown to signal in response to IL-13.
limitations: The receptor is multichain and IL4R/IL13RA1 chain roles differ; species and receptor abundance affect signaling.

assay_or_result: Structural, receptor-assembly, SPR/functional, and knockout studies support IL-17A engagement of IL17RA/IL17RC and receptor-dependent signaling.
limitations: IL-17 receptor stoichiometry is multimeric and IL-17A can also engage other IL-17 receptor assemblies in some contexts.

assay_or_result: The cited receptor-assembly and functional studies include the IL-17A/F heterodimer among ligands requiring/engaging IL17RA and IL17RC signaling contexts.
limitations: The heterodimer can have distinct affinity and receptor stoichiometry; IL17RC homomeric assemblies have also been reported.

assay_or_result: IL-17F is directly included in structural/receptor-assembly and IL17RC-dependent functional studies for the IL17RA/IL17RC signaling context.
limitations: IL-17F can also form IL17RC homomeric complexes, so the submitted heteromer should be interpreted as a documented, not exclusive, receptor assembly.

assay_or_result: IL-22/IL-22R1/IL-10R2 binding and functional receptor assembly are directly demonstrated by radioligand cross-linking, ELISA, and signaling assays.
limitations: IL10RB is shared with other class-II cytokine receptors and IL-22 also has soluble binding-protein biology.

assay_or_result: SPR/TR-FRET and receptor-function studies directly show IL-36alpha binding IL1RL2/IL-36R and recruitment of IL1RAP/IL-1RAcP for activation.
limitations: IL-36 cytokines are processed for full activity and the receptor/co-receptor complex has weak basal interactions without ligand.

assay_or_result: SPR/TR-FRET and cell-surface assays directly show IL-36gamma binding IL1RL2/IL-36R and formation/activation of the IL1RL2-IL1RAP receptor complex.
limitations: IL-36gamma has weaker direct IL1RL2 affinity than IL-36alpha and requires processed active ligand/context for signaling.

assay_or_result: Crystal structure and mutational analysis show IL-4 binding IL4R alpha and recruitment of the common gamma chain in the signaling receptor complex.
limitations: Mature IL-4 and assembled receptor complex are the tested entities; the submitted receptor label is the alpha-chain component.

assay_or_result: Reconstitution, biosensor binding, mutagenesis, and proliferation assays show IL-5 binding IL5R alpha and signaling through the alpha/beta-c heteromer.
limitations: IL5R alpha provides ligand specificity while CSF2RB completes the high-affinity signaling receptor.

assay_or_result: Structural, solution-binding, immunoprecipitation, and signaling studies show IL-6 first binds IL6R alpha and then recruits two gp130/IL6ST chains to form the hexameric signaling complex.
limitations: Hexameric stoichiometry and soluble versus membrane receptor context vary by assay.

assay_or_result: Structural and biophysical studies show IL-7 binding IL7R alpha and recruiting the common gamma chain; functional receptor studies support the heteromeric complex.
limitations: The structural work is human and receptor ectodomain based, with species-dependent functional follow-up.

assay_or_result: IL-9 receptor cloning used radiolabeled IL-9 binding, while cross-linking, immunoprecipitation, heteromerization, and signaling studies identify IL9R with the common gamma chain.
limitations: Some early studies establish receptor composition in murine or human systems separately.

assay_or_result: Cryo-EM, mutagenesis, ligand-binding, and cellular signaling studies test mature insulin engagement of the insulin receptor and identify sites required for receptor activation.
limitations: Ins1 is a precursor gene label; the assayed ligand is processed mature insulin and the receptor is an assembled IR dimer.

assay_or_result: Comparative ligand/metal-ion studies measure VCAM-1 binding to alpha4beta1, and earlier cell adhesion work establishes VCAM-1-dependent alpha4beta1 adhesion.
limitations: Affinity and activation state vary between alpha4beta1 preparations and cellular assays.

assay_or_result: The comparative study directly measures VCAM-1 interaction with alpha9beta1 as well as alpha4beta1, with adhesion assays supporting ligand-dependent cell attachment.
limitations: Alpha9beta1 affinity is weaker than alpha4beta1 in the cited comparison and may depend on divalent cations and assay format.

assay_or_result: Primary JAM studies show heterophilic JAM-B/JAM-C interaction in cell-contact and adhesion assays.
limitations: JAM nomenclature differs across species and older papers; the submitted symbols map to JAM-B and JAM-C.

assay_or_result: KLK14 cleaves/activates PAR1/F2R in peptide and fibroblast assays, and PAR1 antagonism blocks downstream inflammatory signaling.
limitations: The study is recent and uses protease activity plus receptor antagonism rather than a stable ligand-receptor binding assay.
